title: narcissus longispathus subsp. alcaracensis
intro: Narcissus longispathus subsp. alcaracensis, commonly known as Alcaraz narcissus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is a bulbous perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Alcaraz narcissus is known to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help in treating various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant properties.
